notes.title: Update: Setting Game Modes!
notes.notes:
New game modes have been added, which can be enabled before playing:

Free Play: Play without winning, endlessly for as long as you want.
No Events: Disable all events, freely choose religious aspects.
No Loss: Disable atheism and its influence.

Combine these modes for a different gaming experience!

Also:
Various improvements and bug fixes!
Thank you for your feedback! Join our Discord!

notes.title: PC version release
notes.notes:
Early Access for Religion inc PC ends with this update.

During 2 years of early access, we added all the planned religion archetypes to the game and significantly improved the controls for the Steam version.

In the upcoming versions we plan to:
Improve event mechanics for all archetypes. We have already added events to the first archetypes and we are waiting for your feedback on this system.
Add new strategy map and building mechanics, “Hero unit”.
Improve graphics for the PC version and add better visualization of the game logic
Ancient relics in your personal temple.

All this and much more is happening in 2023!
Stay with us and thank you for your attention!

GameFirst team.
Discord for joining the community: https://discord.gg/RGBn9T3
